name: Cup Of Bluff
summary: A dice bluffing duel where players roll secretly, call a chip number, and win it by fooling a chosen opponent about truthfulness.
rules_text: Each player tries to collect chips numbered 3-18 from the center, each with point values (high extremes worth more). On your turn roll 3 dice in a cup and secretly view the sum. Choose an opponent as target; if you want a chip already owned, you must target its owner. Announce a number corresponding to an available chip you don't already own, either truthfully or as a bluff. Target declares "truth" or "bluff". Reveal dice. If target was wrong (you bluffed and they said truth, or vice versa) you win the called chip; if target was right, target wins it. If the called chip was the target's at turn start and you lose, you must also give them one of your chips. If you roll doubles you may instead show them and exchange two or more of your chips for one chip from center of equal total points. Game ends when center is empty; highest points wins, fewest chips breaks ties.
rating_reason: Liar's dice bluffing, hidden dice, turn-based challenge.
